must.title: Security Requirement
must.description: Ensure secure handling of ECA intake_documents.
must.metric: Zero critical vulnerabilities in document handling.
acceptance_criteria: Security scans show zero critical vulnerabilities.
Access controls are verified and enforced.
Data encryption is applied where necessary.
must.verification: Conduct SAST and DAST scans; perform security audits.

must.title: Reliability Requirement
must.description: Ensure reliable processing of ECA intake_documents.
acceptance_criteria: System maintains 99.9% uptime over a 30-day period.
All downtimes are logged and analyzed.
Recovery procedures are documented and tested.
must.verification: Monitor uptime over a rolling 30-day window; verify recovery logs.

should.title: Performance Requirement
should.description: Ensure the system processes intake_documents with minimal latency.
should.metric: Process intake_documents within 200ms for 95% of requests.
acceptance_criteria: 95% of document processing requests complete within 200ms.
Performance metrics are logged and monitored.
should.verification: Load test with simulated document flow; measure p95 response times.

should.title: Scalability Requirement
should.description: Ensure the system can handle increased document flow.
should.metric: Support up to 10,000 concurrent document processing requests.
acceptance_criteria: System supports 10,000 concurrent requests without failure.
Scalability metrics are logged and monitored.
should.verification: Stress test with increasing load; monitor system performance.
